subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Utilizar, ao produzir texto, conhecimentos linguísticos e gramaticais: ortografia, regências e concordâncias nominal e verbal, modos e tempos verbais, pontuação etc.

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras e padrões de ortografia para corrigir palavras mal escritas
components.description_en: Apply spelling rules and patterns to correct misspelled words in writing
components.cc_component_description: Apply spelling rules and patterns to correct misspelled words in writing

components.description_pt: Aplicar regras de concordância nominal e verbal na produção textual
components.description_en: Apply rules of nominal and verbal agreement in text production
components.cc_component_description: Use correct noun and verb agreement in written and spoken sentences

components.description_pt: Formar e usar verbos nos modos indicativo, imperativo, interrogativo, condicional e subjuntivo
components.description_en: Form and use verbs in the indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive moods
components.cc_component_description: Form and use verbs in the indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive moods

components.description_pt: Aplicar corretamente regência verbal e nominal em textos escritos
components.description_en: Apply verbal and nominal government (valency) correctly in written texts

components.description_pt: Usar convenções de pontuação para transmitir significado e clareza em sentenças
components.description_en: Use punctuation conventions to convey meaning and clarity in written sentences
components.cc_component_description: Use punctuation conventions to convey meaning and clarity in written sentences
